an10.19:1.1: dasayime bhikkhave ariyavāsā ye ariyā āvasiṃsu vā āvasanti vā āvasissanti vā
an10.19:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti chaḷaṅgasamannāgato ekārakkho caturāpasseno panuṇṇapaccekasacco samavayasaṭṭhesano anāvilasaṅkappo passaddhakāyasaṃkhāro suvimuttacitto suvimuttapañño
an10.19:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa ariyavāsā ye ariyā āvasiṃsu vā āvasanti vā āvasissanti vāti.
